# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish RSI divergence at a VWAP reclaim indicates weakening selling pressure and a likely bounce. We aim to capture long entries where price reclaims VWAP from below while showing hidden bullish momentum via RSI divergence, filtered by volume confirmation and regime conditions.

## Mechanism

Entry: Price crosses above VWAP from below (on 5m bar) AND RSI(14) makes a higher low while price makes a lower low within the last 3 bars AND volume on the reclaim bar > 1.5× average volume of prior 5 bars. Exit: Initial stop at the low of the divergence bar. TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward). Runner trailed by chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filters: VIX < 22, time after 09:45 EST, and 5m market structure showing a higher low (no fresh lower low) in the last 20 bars.
